Our story

From a rescued bottle to your table

Every LaFrance candle starts as a wine or liquor bottle that was headed for the trash. Chrissy LaFrance — owner and operator, right here in Spanish Fort — rescues each bottle, cuts and smooths it by hand, and pours it into a candle. The labels she keeps, the color of the glass, the shape of the bottle: all of it carries over. That’s why no two candles are ever alike — every candle is a rescued bottle.

1 · RescueA bottle gets a second life instead of a landfill.
2 · CutCut and smoothed by hand, label details kept.
3 · PourHand-poured in small batches in Spanish Fort.
